Spreads

Top: spread, month i minus month j. Bottom: percentile. Warm: flat or backwardated for that pair.
Data as of the latest market close. For informational purposes only. Spread = sell-leg month minus buy-leg month, so a higher value is flatter or more backwardated. 1Y, 2Y and 5Y rank against that many trading days up to the date; Lifetime ranks against all history up to the date; Full sample ranks against all history including later dates, so it uses hindsight. Months are counted by monthly expiry. History before 2007 is thin and is on the rescaled basis.
